title: Representation embeddings and the third Brauer–Thrall conjecture
abstract: A Lean 4 formalization, built on Mathlib, of the principal results of the paper Representation embeddings and the third Brauer–Thrall conjecture. Over an algebraically closed field, every representation-infinite finite-dimensional algebra admits a faithful representation embedding of a colimit-closed category of Kronecker modules that preserves infinite dimensions (Theorem A). Hence, for every infinite cardinal κ, it has 2^κ pairwise non-isomorphic indecomposable modules of dimension κ whose endomorphism rings are local with residue field k and whose radicals satisfy (rad End M)^n = 0 for one n ≤ max(30, 4 dim A) independent of κ; for κ ≥ |k| this is the largest possible number (Corollary 1.1, in full). Weaker parts of the corollary are also compared: modules of every infinite dimension, the endomorphism control without the count and the bound, and the count without the bound. The cited inputs are proved in the library: Bongartz's Theorem 6 and Göbel and Simson's rigid families over infinite fields.
